messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> High error rate and egress latency spike detected in eu-central1 cluster (service: inference-serve, region: eu-central1). 5xx rate 18% over baseline, p95 latency 2.8s. Alert ID: PAG-48291.

dan-oncall: on it. paging in. starting live triage.

dan-oncall: quick check — are we seeing infra-level PacketLoss or backend 503s? frank-netops can you confirm peering/eBGP churn?

frank-netops: seeing an uptick in retransmits on the eu-central1 egress NATs, looks like a peering flap with provider X around 14:23 UTC. BGP flaps correlate with pushes to the egress gateways.

ben-sre: confirming service-level logs show repeated upstream 502/504 from edge->egress-proxy. KV cache hits unaffected. This looks like egress path to provider X is dropping sessions.

dan-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic off problematic egress pop, 2) failover to eu-west1 for regional customers where allowed, 3) temporarily enable degraded-mode (no heavy reranking) for cross-region requests.

carmen-pm: customer impact? which customers are in scope for immediate notice?

elena-support: tickets already popped — some EU customers report generation timeouts and errors. Should send initial status notice (investigating).

grace-comm: drafting status page and customer note. Proposed status update (short):

```
We are investigating elevated errors and latency for API requests routed through eu-central1. Engineers are actively mitigating; traffic is being routed to alternate POPs where possible. We will post updates every 15 minutes. Customers experiencing timeouts may see reduced performance for models that require large egress bandwidth or third-party peering. (Incident ID: INC-2026-48291)
```

grace-comm: customer notification draft (for affected tenants):

```
Hi — we are currently investigating intermittent errors and slow responses for requests routed through eu-central1. We have begun diverting traffic to alternate regions and expect reduced errors within ~30-45 minutes. No customer data was exposed. We will follow up when routing is fully restored and with a post-incident summary.

If you need immediate assistance or have stricter routing requirements (e.g., EU-only), reply and we will escalate to a private channel.
```

dan-oncall: executing traffic shift to eu-west1 for non-eu-only customers. Command:

```
# promote-route sets
redwoodctl routing promote --from eu-central1 --to eu-west1 --service inference-serve --scope non-eu-only --dry-run=false
```

ben-sre: applied promote-route. Observability: 5xx dropping from 18% -> 6% within 4 minutes, p95 latency improving to 1.1s on diverted flows.

frank-netops: peering vendor acknowledges degraded link and is performing mitigations. We should keep reroute until vendor confirms stable.

elena-support: posting initial status page now and sending targeted customer pings to top 20 affected accounts.

grace-comm: status page update posted. Slack #customers-notify ping queued for review.

carmen-pm: do we need to restrict model set during degraded mode? some heavier models (long-context) still spike errors.

ben-sre: yes, enabling degraded-mode flag for large-context routes. Config snippet:

```
routes: 
  - name: large-context
    degrade: true
    degrade_policy: reduce_reranker | disable_streaming
```

dan-oncall: enabled degrade for large-context routes. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Note: dan-oncall has escalated to ben-sre (handoff). New pager: ben-sre.

ben-sre: I'm on it for the next hour — will continue mitigation and coordinate with frank for peering. dan please add any runbook steps you ran.

dan-oncall: added steps to the thread: 1) routing promote, 2) toggle degraded-mode for heavy models, 3) increase autoscale headroom on eu-west1 nodes (to absorb burst). Commands run:

```
redwoodctl autoscale set --pool eu-west1-inference --min 8 --max 120
redwoodctl routing promote --from eu-central1 --to eu-west1 --service inference-serve --scope non-eu-only
redwoodctl config set inference.degraded_mode.large_context true
```

ben-sre: autoscale headroom observed to spin up additional pods; metrics confirm new capacity hitting 70% of target. Errors now trending to baseline (~1%).

frank-netops: vendor reports partial stabilization but with a residual packet-loss window; recommending keep reroute for 2 hours and then test backfill gradually.

grace-comm: updated customer note: added ETA and mitigation steps. Sent to impacted list.

elena-support: bumped priority on open tickets and informed top customers we've initiated cross-region failover and will provide timeline.

ben-sre: scheduled controlled backfill plan: at T+2h run gradual traffic re-injection test to eu-central1 5% -> 25% -> 50% with watch windows. If errors spike, revert. Documented in playbook.

carmen-pm: what's the internal severity and follow-up? propose Sev2 (production impact for subset of customers). Need RCA owners.

dan-oncall: agree Sev2. Ben -> RCA lead. Frank -> network vendor liaison. Grace -> customer comms for RCA.

incident-bot: Update: last_message_ts set to 1898004567.

ben-sre: Post-mitigation summary to paste into incident tracker:

```
Summary: peering flap with vendor X caused elevated retransmits and upstream 5xx in eu-central1 egress cluster. Immediate mitigation: diverted traffic to eu-west1 for non-EU-only tenants, enabled degraded-mode for heavy-model routes, increased autoscale headroom. Result: errors reduced from 18% -> ~1% and latency returned near baseline. Vendor to provide full peering incident report. Follow-up: RCA, improved egress failover test coverage, and status page postmortem.
```

grace-comm: I'll prepare the public postmortem draft and internal template. ETA for postmortem draft: 48 hours.

elena-support: closing loop with customers as they confirm recovery. will consolidate customer impact list for RCA.

carmen-pm: adding action items to roadmap: (1) automated cross-pop routing on peering degradation, (2) rehearse controlled backfill playbook quarterly, (3) update compliance notes for EU-only flagged tenants.

ben-sre: handing back to dan-oncall for final checks and runbook updates.

dan-oncall: thanks all. leaving note: monitor for 60m, then hand to next-day oncall for RCA follow-up.

elena-support: acknowledged.

grace-comm: thanks — will post postmortem draft when ready. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-48291 transitioned to Mitigated. Next steps: RCA assigned, postmortem in 48h, customer follow-up complete.
